options.name: data
options.description: This is the value of the record, depending on the record type.

options.name: flags
options.description: An unsignedinteger between 0-255 used for CAA records.

options.name: force_update
options.description: If there is already a record with the same C(name) and C(type) force update it.

options.name: name
options.description: Required for C(A, AAAA, CNAME, TXT, SRV) records. The host name, alias, or service being defined by the record.

options.name: oauth_token
options.description: DigitalOcean OAuth token. Can be specified in C(DO_API_KEY), C(DO_API_TOKEN), or C(DO_OAUTH_TOKEN) environment variables

options.name: port
options.description: The port that the service is accessible on for SRV records only.

options.name: priority
options.description: The priority of the host for C(SRV, MX) records).

options.name: record_id
options.description: Used with C(force_update=yes) and C(state='absent') to update or delete a specific record.

options.name: state
options.description: Indicate desired state of the target.

options.name: tag
options.description: The parameter tag for CAA records.

options.name: ttl
options.description: Time to live for the record, in seconds.

options.name: type
options.description: The type of record you would like to create.

options.name: weight
options.description: The weight of records with the same priority for SRV records only.
